rows.heading: Heart Beneath Petals
rows.body: A fan of pink petals sits at the lobe, and an openwork turquoise frame leads down to a pink heart ringed in blue that sways with each step.

rows.heading: Two Colours, Crisp
rows.body: Heart-cut pink cubic zirconia sits in a rhodium-plated setting ringed with turquoise-blue stones, and the bright white metal keeps both colours crisp against a pink saree.

rows.heading: Said With Hearts
rows.body: Pink and turquoise rarely meet this sweetly. Give them to your wife on your anniversary, and let them carry the whole dinner without a word.

rows.heading: Layer Upon Layer
rows.body: Rows of petals open around a clear round centre, deep blue inside and paler blue at the edges, so the flower seems to unfold across your finger.

rows.heading: Deep Blue Fire
rows.body: Blue cubic zirconia in two shades, dark at the heart and lighter towards the edge, is outlined in clear stones on a rhodium-plated setting that sharpens every petal.

rows.heading: Sized by You
rows.body: The open band adjusts to fit, so there is no guessing her size. Give it to a sister on her birthday, or wear it solo on date night.

rows.heading: Full-Circle Flower
rows.body: Tiers of red petals circle a single clear stone, each one edged in white sparkle, so the flower looks full and round from across the room.

rows.heading: Red, Outlined Bright
rows.body: Rose-red cubic zirconia is framed in clear stones on a rhodium-plated band, and that cool white outline makes the red look richer, even against plain denim.

rows.heading: Boishakh Ready
rows.body: Red and white belong to Pohela Boishakh, and this ring carries both. Wear it with a red-bordered white saree; the open band adjusts to your finger.

rows.heading: Collar of Light
rows.body: Clear pear-shaped stones widen into a collar that sits close around the neck, meeting at one rectangular pink stone, with matching earrings in pink and clear.

rows.heading: Blush at Centre
rows.body: A rectangular pink cubic zirconia anchors rows of clear pear and round cuts on a rhodium-plated setting, and all that white light makes the single pink glow warmer.

rows.heading: Ear to Collarbone
rows.body: Matched from ear to collarbone, it takes the guesswork out of dressing for a biye. Give it to the bride-to-be, or wear it as her proudest guest.

rows.heading: Garland of Leaves
rows.body: Olive pear-shaped stones alternate with leaf sprays along the chain, gathering into a pendant drop in a leafy halo that rests below your collarbone, with earrings to match.

rows.heading: Gold Warms Green
rows.body: Pear and marquise-cut olive cubic zirconia sit in gold-plated metal with clear accents, and the warm gold brings out the yellow in the green, soft rather than sharp.

rows.heading: Holud Colours
rows.body: At a gaye holud, where yellow and green fill the room, olive and gold blend right in. A thoughtful gift for a sister's big week.

name: Luminescent Pink Water Drop Bridal Set

rows.heading: Half and Half
rows.body: Clear stone clusters run down one side and pink pear drops down the other, meeting at a point where a short pink tail falls, with earrings to match.

rows.heading: Pink Beside Clear
rows.body: Pear-cut pink cubic zirconia sits beside clear stones on a rhodium-plated setting, and the bright white metal lets the pink stay soft while the clear side flashes.

rows.heading: Bou-Bhat Blush
rows.body: Soft enough for a pastel saree, bright enough for the stage. Wear it to your bou-bhat, or give it to a friend who wears pink better than anyone.

rows.heading: Wings Over Pearl
rows.body: Four red pear-shaped stones open like wings at the lobe, outlined in clear sparkle, and a short line of round stones lets one white pearl swing beneath.

rows.heading: Red, Softened
rows.body: Pear-cut red cubic zirconia sits in a rhodium-plated frame paved with clear stones, so the red looks deeper, and the round pearl below softens it all.

rows.heading: Birthday Favourite
rows.body: Give them on a birthday, then watch her wear them to every dinner after. A touch of red that pairs as easily with ivory as with black.

rows.heading: Crowned Pearl Drop
rows.body: An oval green stone in a scalloped frame starts the drop, a small round green stone follows, and a capped pearl hangs below, swaying as you move.

rows.heading: White Lifts Colour
rows.body: Oval and round green cubic zirconia are ringed by clear stones in a silver-tone setting, while the pearl's soft white lifts the colour, even beside a green saree.

rows.heading: Eid Morning
rows.body: Green feels right on Eid morning, and the pearl keeps it graceful through a full day of visits. An easy Eid gift for your mother or sister.

rows.heading: Pearl Sunburst
rows.body: Curved rays of clear stones fan out from a round white pearl like a firework caught mid-burst, sitting bold across the lobe and catching light from every side.

rows.heading: Glow Meets Glint
rows.body: Rows of cubic zirconia pavé run along each silver-tone ray, and the pearl's quiet glow at the centre keeps all that sparkle from feeling cold.

rows.heading: Hair Swept Up
rows.body: Sweep your hair back for an evening dawat and let the rays do the talking. A neat gift for a sister who prefers studs to anything that dangles.

rows.heading: Lace-Capped Pearl
rows.body: A clear pear-shaped stud gives way to a lacy cap of sparkling scallops holding one large teardrop pearl, which swings softly as you turn.

rows.heading: White on White
rows.body: A pear-cut cubic zirconia and an open pavé cap in a silver-tone setting frame the pearl, pairing crisp sparkle with a soft milky sheen for an ivory saree.

rows.heading: Bride Without Fuss
rows.body: For the bride who wants pearls without fuss. They sit neatly beside a heavy wedding dupatta, then stay simple enough to wear on ordinary days after.

rows.heading: Flowers That Climb
rows.body: Each earring is a turquoise flower with a pink heart at its centre on a curving stem with leaves, one blooming low on the ear, the other high.

rows.heading: Pastels Kept Clear
rows.body: A heart-cut pink cubic zirconia sits at each centre, ringed in lilac and turquoise pavé on a rhodium-plated setting that keeps the pastels light and clear.

rows.heading: Playfully Unmatched
rows.body: A pair that does not match, on purpose. Wear them to university with a plain kurti and let the flowers start the conversation.

rows.heading: Every Petal Different
rows.body: Five rounded petals each wear a different colour, blue, orange, pink and two soft lilacs, around a white pearly centre, and the stud sits snug on the lobe.

rows.heading: Warm Rose Setting
rows.body: Multicoloured cubic zirconia is paved petal by petal over rose gold plating, and that warm pink metal ties the brights together so they read as one bloom.

rows.heading: Why Pick One
rows.body: Too cheerful to save for weddings. Wear them with a printed salwar kameez to a weekend lunch, or give them to a friend who can never pick one colour.

rows.heading: Striped Cushion Dome
rows.body: A cushion-shaped dome with softened corners is striped in rows of green and clear stones, curving over the lobe so it catches light from the side too.

rows.heading: Neat Green Rows
rows.body: Tiny green and clear cubic zirconia are set in neat rows on gold-plated metal, and the warm yellow behind them makes the green look deep and fresh.

rows.heading: Sunday to Friday
rows.body: A pair you can wear to the office on Sunday and to a dawat on Friday night. Give them to a colleague who likes her studs bold.

rows.heading: Curling Tendrils
rows.body: Pointed red-speckled petals open around curling gold-tone tendrils, and a round white pearl tucks in just below, so the flower seems to cradle it at your lobe.

rows.heading: Rosy on Gold
rows.body: Red and clear cubic zirconia trace each petal in a gold-tone setting, and the warm metal turns the red rosier while the pearl adds a soft, milky finish.

rows.heading: Wedding Guest Ready
rows.body: Pair them with a magenta or red saree for a cousin's biye, and the pearl keeps the look soft rather than loud. A sweet gift for a sister-in-law.

rows.heading: Ruffled Petals
rows.body: Ruffled petals, paved edge to edge, fold like a fresh flower around a golden centre dotted with tiny coloured stones, sitting wide and bright on the lobe.

rows.heading: Sunlit Sparkle
rows.body: Clear cubic zirconia covers every petal on an 18k gold-plated setting, and the yellow glowing through the gaps warms the sparkle to the colour of sunlight.

rows.heading: Flowers for Her
rows.body: Give her flowers that keep. A warm, golden pair for your mother to wear with a cream-and-gold saree to every wedding this winter.

rows.heading: Twisted Ribbon
rows.body: An open crescent of clear pavé twists like a ribbon, with green marquise stones spiralling along the curve, sitting at the lobe like a hoop lit from within.

rows.heading: Cool, Crisp Green
rows.body: Marquise-cut green cubic zirconia runs through dense clear pavé on a rhodium-plated setting, and that cool white base keeps the green crisp, like leaves after rain.

rows.heading: Catch the Flash
rows.body: Wear them to a reception, when the lights are low and everyone is taking photos. Tuck your hair behind one ear and let the green catch the flash.

rows.heading: Starry Petals
rows.body: A star-like flower of pointed petals rests on the lobe, and a single teardrop pearl hangs just beneath it, moving a little with every word you say.

rows.heading: Ice and Cream
rows.body: Every pointed petal is paved in clear cubic zirconia on a rhodium-plated setting, and that icy white sparkle sets off the pearl's warmer, creamier glow.

rows.heading: Your Ivory Day
rows.body: Ivory saree, hair pinned low, pearls at your ears. Wear them on your wedding day, then again each anniversary when the photos come out.

rows.heading: Wide Open Bloom
rows.body: Broad petals edged in turquoise open wide around a ring of pink marquise stones and a blue oval centre, covering the lobe like a flower pinned in place.

rows.heading: Three Shades Layered
rows.body: Turquoise, pink and clear cubic zirconia layer outward from a blue centre stone on a rhodium-plated setting, and the white metal keeps each shade distinct and bright.

rows.heading: Necklace Optional
rows.body: Wear them with a cream saree to your sister's engagement and skip the necklace altogether. A cheerful gift for anyone who loves turquoise.

rows.heading: Plume in Motion
rows.body: A grey pearl sits at the lobe, and beneath it a fan of pavé rays flares downward like a feather, each pointed tip glinting as you move.

rows.heading: Soft Grey Glow
rows.body: Micro-pavé cubic zirconia runs down every silver-tone feather line, and the grey pearl adds a cool, smoky lustre that feels quieter than white and more modern.

rows.heading: Convocation Day
rows.body: Grey feels grown-up without trying. Wear them to your convocation and the family dinner after, or give a pair to the friend who graduated beside you.

rows.heading: Three Tiers Falling
rows.body: Little flowers in pink and clear, green leaves and small pearls step down in three tiers to a blush flower, finished by a swaying teardrop pearl.

rows.heading: Pale Pink, Warmed
rows.body: Pink, clear and green cubic zirconia sit in a gold-tone setting with pearls between them, and the warm metal keeps the pale pink from looking washed out.

rows.heading: Made for Dancing
rows.body: Long enough to show through loose hair, they move with every laugh. Wear them to a friend's gaye holud, where the dancing starts early and ends late.

rows.heading: Drop by Drop
rows.body: A small purple pear in a clear halo leads to a spray of lilac marquise stones, then a large purple teardrop, haloed in clear, swings below the lobe.

rows.heading: Royal Purple Halo
rows.body: Pear and marquise-cut purple cubic zirconia are ringed with clear stones in a silver-tone setting, and that bright border makes the purple look deeper.

rows.heading: No Piercing Needed
rows.body: The clip-on fit needs no piercing, a kind gift for a mother or aunt with unpierced ears. Pair them with a lilac saree for a family wedding.

rows.heading: Chunky Golden Curve
rows.body: A chunky half-hoop, full and rounded through the middle, hugs the lobe, its clear pavé dotted all over with little red stones that wink as you move.

rows.heading: Scattered Red
rows.body: Clear cubic zirconia is paved across the gold-plated curve with round red stones set in at random, and the warm gold beneath makes the red stand out.

rows.heading: Eid Afternoon Shine
rows.body: Made for Eid afternoons, when the whole family visits and nobody leaves before tea. A fine gift for the friend who never skips earrings.

rows.heading: Garden Wreath
rows.body: A round pearl sits at the centre of a wreath of blue and green stones, with little clear flowers tucked between them, held flat and close against the lobe.

rows.heading: Jewel-Tone Contrast
rows.body: Navy-blue and green cubic zirconia circle the pearl's soft white glow, and clear pavé petals in a bright silver-tone setting keep the deep colours crisp and lively.

rows.heading: Wedding Week Classic
rows.body: Worn from the first wedding dawat to the bou-bhat, they sit close and comfortable all day, and make a thoughtful gift for a sister getting married.

rows.heading: Playful Splash
rows.body: A little fish curls upward with its fins and tail fanned out in fuchsia, blush and orange, covering the lobe like a bright flick of water.

rows.heading: Warm Rose Glow
rows.body: Pink cubic zirconia in several shades is packed scale by scale over a rose-gold-tone setting, whose warm glow makes the pinks look softer and the orange accents brighter.

rows.heading: Conversation Starter
rows.body: The pair people ask about at a birthday dinner or a cousin's wedding, and a sweet, unexpected gift for the friend who never wears what everyone else does.

rows.heading: Petals to Pearl
rows.body: Pink petals fan open at the lobe, a tiny blue flower links them to a petal cap, and an oval pearl hangs beneath, swinging softly at your jawline.

rows.heading: Blush Over White
rows.body: Pink cubic zirconia is laid edge to edge across each petal in a silver-tone setting, so the blush colour sparkles brightly above the pearl's soft white sheen.

rows.heading: Framing Your Face
rows.body: Long enough to frame your face in every photo, these belong at an engagement, beside a soft pink saree and a room full of flowers.

rows.heading: Curled Petals
rows.body: Five curled petals open around a pearl centre, each petal rimmed in sparkle, so the flower sits neatly on the lobe and catches light at every curl.

rows.heading: Cream and Gold
rows.body: Clear cubic zirconia traces each petal of a gold-tone brass flower, and that warm metal makes the white pearl at its heart look soft and creamy.

rows.heading: Desk to Dawat
rows.body: Small enough for a workday, bright enough for an evening dawat, these are the pair you reach for when you cannot decide.

rows.heading: Sunny Centre
rows.body: Petals tipped in turquoise blue open around a square yellow centre, and a round pearl hangs just below like a dewdrop on a flower.

rows.heading: Sky and Sunshine
rows.body: A square-cut yellow stone sits inside petals paved in turquoise-blue and clear cubic zirconia, and the bright silver-tone setting keeps both colours fresh against the pearl.

rows.heading: Holud Day Colours
rows.body: Sunny yellow and sky blue feel right at home at a gaye holud among marigolds, and they make a cheerful gift for the bride-to-be.

rows.heading: Cradled Pearl
rows.body: A long, open curve drops from the lobe and cradles a single pearl at its base, so the pearl peeks out from inside the hoop as you turn.

rows.heading: Golden Frame
rows.body: Micro-pavé cubic zirconia lines the front of each 18k gold-plated hoop, and that warm, polished shine sets off the pearl's creamy white glow.

rows.heading: Hers Every Day
rows.body: Give them to your wife for an anniversary, and watch them go from a weekday kurti to a dinner out without needing anything else.

rows.heading: Seashell Treasure
rows.body: A fan of sparkling ribs opens like a seashell on the lobe, with a round pearl resting at its hinge, a small treasure held close to the ear.

rows.heading: Ridges of Light
rows.body: Row upon row of clear cubic zirconia follows each ridge of the rhodium-plated shell, so the white sparkle frames the pearl and makes its soft sheen glow.

rows.heading: Ivory Evenings
rows.body: Wear them with an ivory saree to a wedding evening, or give them to the friend who still collects shells from every trip to the sea.

rows.heading: Chrysanthemum Burst
rows.body: Long petals burst outward from a single red centre like a chrysanthemum in full bloom, covering the lobe with a wide, bright starburst that reads from across the room.

rows.heading: Shades of Pink
rows.body: Clear and pale pink cubic zirconia pave each petal, with deeper red stones running down the middle, and the rose-gold-tone setting warms every shade of pink.

rows.heading: Let Them Talk
rows.body: Pair them with a plain kurti or a simple white saree and let them do the talking, all the way from lunch with friends to date night.

rows.heading: Firework Ring
rows.body: A small sunburst stud holds an open circle of rays below it, so the ring of red and white sways and flashes like a firework beside your neck.

rows.heading: Red on White
rows.body: Marquise-cut red and clear cubic zirconia alternate around the circle in a bright silver-tone setting, and that white metal makes the red read deeper and richer.

rows.heading: Biye Night Spark
rows.body: Made for a biye night, when a red saree wants earrings bright enough to answer it from across a crowded hall.

rows.heading: Pooled Light
rows.body: An oval stone sits at the lobe and a long open teardrop of pavé hangs from it, widening at the bottom where the light pools.

rows.heading: Champagne Accent
rows.body: Micro-paved cubic zirconia covers every curve of the gold-tone teardrop, and an oval champagne stone above it adds a soft peachy warmth to all that white sparkle.

rows.heading: Hair Swept Aside
rows.body: Wear them to a friend's biye with your hair swept to one side, and let that warm golden length catch the camera flash each time you laugh.

rows.heading: Bloom and Bud
rows.body: One ear wears an open pink bloom with a leafy stem trailing below, the other a bud on a longer stem, a mismatched pair that sways like cut flowers.

rows.heading: Petal and Leaf
rows.body: Deep pink cubic zirconia covers every petal around a black and white centre, green stones trace each leaf, and the dark-toned stem makes both colours look richer.

rows.heading: The Hidden Bud
rows.body: For date night, tuck your hair behind one ear to show off the bloom, and let the bud on the other side be the little surprise.

rows.heading: Crowned Teardrop
rows.body: A fan of clear marquise stones crowns the lobe, and below it a long pear-shaped drop in a fine sparkling halo sways below the jaw.

rows.heading: Green Into Violet
rows.body: The pear-cut cubic zirconia shifts from sea green at the top into deep violet, and the warm gold-tone setting around it keeps that purple glowing rather than cool.

rows.heading: Colour Lover's Gift
rows.body: Wear them to a birthday party with a plum saree and let one pair carry the whole look, or gift them to someone who never shies away from colour.

rows.heading: Little Blue Dome
rows.body: A plump teardrop curves down the lobe and tucks under at the bottom, its domed face covered in tiny turquoise-blue stones that read as one bold colour.

rows.heading: Fresh Turquoise
rows.body: Turquoise-blue cubic zirconia is packed stone to stone over a gold-plated dome, and the warm shine peeking between them makes the blue look even fresher.

rows.heading: Weekday Brights
rows.body: Close-fitting and easy, they add one bright note to a teal saree or a plain white salwar kameez, from university mornings to long office days.

rows.heading: Starburst Drop
rows.body: A starburst stud sits at the lobe, and beneath it a large pear-shaped stone wrapped in pointed petals falls toward the jaw, wide and bright like a bridal bloom.

rows.heading: All White Fire
rows.body: A large pear-cut stone sits inside a ring of marquise-cut ones, all clear cubic zirconia, so the drop flashes pure white light from every angle.

rows.heading: Bridal Spotlight
rows.body: Meant for the bride on her biye day, or the sister standing beside her, bold enough to hold their own next to a heavy bridal lehenga.

rows.heading: Gentle Pendulum
rows.body: A sparkling hook slips through the ear and a large round pearl hangs from a pavé cap beneath it, swaying softly with every step you take.

rows.heading: Crisp Meets Soft
rows.body: Clear cubic zirconia runs down the rhodium-plated hook and covers the little cap, and that crisp sparkle above makes the pearl's sheen look even softer.

rows.heading: For Your Mother
rows.body: A gift your mother will actually wear, with a white saree to a niece's birthday or an afternoon visit, pearls that never ask for attention but always get it.

rows.heading: Draped in Sparkle
rows.body: A clear pear-shaped stone sits at the lobe under a tiny crown, and below it a pearl hangs inside a sparkling cap whose tendrils drip down its sides.

rows.heading: Candlelit Warmth
rows.body: Clear cubic zirconia frames the pear-cut centre and pours down over the pearl in a gold-tone setting, whose warmth gives the white stones and pearl a soft candlelit glow.

rows.heading: Over the Shoulder
rows.body: Wear them to a reception with a cream and gold saree, so the pearls show with every glance over your shoulder.

rows.heading: Oval and Orb
rows.body: A large oval of green sits flat against the lobe, and a round pearl hangs below it under a little sparkling cap, swinging just enough to catch the eye.

rows.heading: Green Kept Bright
rows.body: Oval-cut green cubic zirconia is edged with tiny clear stones in a silver-tone setting, and the cool metal keeps the green bright and the pearl looking crisp white.

rows.heading: Eid in Green
rows.body: Eid calls for a green saree and something festive, and these carry you easily from the morning visits to the last guest at night.

rows.heading: Clover and Teardrop
rows.body: Three red pear-shaped stones gather into a little clover at the lobe, and a teardrop pearl falls from a petal cap beneath, swaying gently as you walk.

rows.heading: Gilded Red
rows.body: Pear-cut red cubic zirconia, each framed in clear pavé, sits on a gold-plated setting, and the warm finish deepens the red while the pearl cools it down.

rows.heading: Red and White
rows.body: Red and white are the colours of Pohela Boishakh, and these carry them in one small, sweet drop that feels just as right on an ordinary office day.

rows.heading: Little Pink Heart
rows.body: A small pink heart sits right on the lobe with a round pearl dropping just beneath it, a short, sweet line that stays neat from morning to night.

rows.heading: Sparkle Outline
rows.body: Two pink cubic zirconia stones meet to form the heart, ringed in clear pavé on a silver-tone setting, so the pink looks soft and bright above the pearl.

rows.heading: Sweet Without Trying
rows.body: Give them to your sister on her birthday, or wear them yourself with a pink saree when you want to look sweet without trying too hard.

rows.heading: Tulip Drop
rows.body: A tiny pink flower at the lobe leads down a line of three clear stones to a tulip-shaped cap, where a blush pearl hangs like a falling petal.

rows.heading: Blush and Aqua
rows.body: Tiny pink and turquoise-blue stones edge the petals of each silver-tone cap, and those cool and warm accents bring out the soft pink lustre of the pearl.

rows.heading: Old-World Romance
rows.body: Wear them with a simple top on a lazy weekend afternoon or to a candlelit dinner, and enjoy a little vintage charm either way.

rows.heading: Chandelier Swing
rows.body: Green pear drops hang at different lengths from a sparkling gold-tone frame, the largest at the very bottom, so the whole chandelier sways like a tassel as you move.

rows.heading: Sea-Glass Green
rows.body: Pear-cut green cubic zirconia hangs beneath clear pavé on a gold-tone frame, and the warm metal brings out the green's soft, sea-glass depth.

rows.heading: Vintage Drama
rows.body: An anniversary gift with a little vintage drama, they suit a cream or green saree and look just as right at a family wedding as at dinner for two.

rows.heading: Lacy Cascade
rows.body: A violet stone at the lobe opens into a lacy fan of clear petals and leaves, ending in three violet drops that swing like a small chandelier.

rows.heading: Cool Violet Sparkle
rows.body: Pear-cut violet zircons, each ringed in tiny clear stones, sit among marquise-cut clear ones in a silver-tone setting that keeps the purple cool and the sparkle bright.

rows.heading: Winter Wedding Night
rows.body: Save them for a winter wedding night with a lilac saree, so every turn of your head sends a small flash of violet across the room.

rows.heading: Sunlit Drop
rows.body: A clear flower sits at the lobe, two round links trail below, and a yellow teardrop framed in sparkle swings at the end with every turn of your head.

rows.heading: Canary Bright
rows.body: Pear-cut yellow zircon is ringed with clear stones in a silver-tone setting, and that cool white outline keeps the yellow looking clean and sunny rather than brassy.

rows.heading: Little Sunshine
rows.body: A sweet birthday gift for a sister, or your own pick for a dinner out with a pale saree, adding a little sunshine at each ear.

rows.heading: Layers of Red
rows.body: A red stud ringed in sparkle leads to a second haloed flower, and a cluster of red teardrops fans out beneath it, swaying softly as you move.

rows.heading: Rich Against Maroon
rows.body: Round and pear-cut crimson zircon sits in a gold-tone setting with clear stone halos, so the red reads rich against warm metal and a deep maroon saree.

rows.heading: Wedding Guest Pick
rows.body: Pin your hair into a low bun for a cousin's wedding, and let these carry all the colour while the rest of your look stays simple.

rows.heading: Three Jewel Tones
rows.body: Three rectangular stones stack in a clean line, green at the top, honey in the middle and the largest, deep blue, at the base, hanging neatly along the jaw.

rows.heading: Framed in Gold
rows.body: Rectangular-cut zircon in green, honey and blue sits in gold-plated frames edged with clear stones, so each colour glows deeper, especially against a navy saree.

rows.heading: Day Into Dawat
rows.body: Wear them with a plain kurti through the day, then straight on to an evening dawat, where three colours do all the talking for you.

rows.heading: Garden Cascade
rows.body: A raspberry-pink bud opens at the lobe, then aqua, green and yellow stones tumble down like a small bouquet, finishing in a soft pink drop at the tip.

rows.heading: Every Shade Clear
rows.body: Pear and marquise zircon in pink, aqua, green and yellow sits in a gold-plated setting, and the warm metal gives the pastel shades a soft, sunny glow.

rows.heading: Farewell Day Colour
rows.body: Wear them to a university farewell with a pastel saree, where they pick up every colour around them, or gift them to the niece who never dresses quietly.

rows.heading: Fan and Fringe
rows.body: A sparkling teardrop stud opens into a fan of red and blush-pink petals, and two slim strands of stones sway beneath it, each ending in a tiny pink drop.

rows.heading: Crimson With Blush
rows.body: Pear-cut crimson zircon is circled by pale pink stones on gold-plated metal, a soft surround that deepens the red and sits beautifully with a magenta or maroon saree.

rows.heading: Long Evening Sway
rows.body: For a bou-bhat evening or a date night, sweep your hair to one side and let the long strands catch the light each time you turn.

rows.heading: Colour Ladder
rows.body: Blue, green and soft pink rectangles step down in a slim line, each ringed in sparkle, and a large yellow teardrop swings at the end, long and lively.

rows.heading: Cut for Fire
rows.body: Rectangles of deep blue, green and blush cubic zirconia sit in clear halos above a lemon-yellow pear, all on a warm gold-tone setting that keeps each colour vivid.

rows.heading: Mehendi Night Brights
rows.body: Wrap them for a friend's birthday, or wear them to a mehendi night with a bright lehenga, where colour that long reads happy from across the room.

rows.heading: Two-Flower Drop
rows.body: A blue flower and a yellow flower sit one below the other, dotted with tiny green stones, and a blue teardrop swings beneath them as you turn.

rows.heading: Blue Meets Yellow
rows.body: Pear-cut zircon petals in sea blue and soft yellow circle clear centres on a gold-tone setting, and the warm metal makes the blue look brighter, like water in sunlight.

rows.heading: Holud Stage Garden
rows.body: On the gaye holud stage in yellow or blue, these bring a small garden to your ears and stay bright in every photo taken that day.

rows.heading: Triangle Meets Teardrop
rows.body: A red triangle sits on the lobe, a small sparkling star links it to a deep purple teardrop, and the drop moves with a short, easy swing.

rows.heading: Red Over Violet
rows.body: Trillion-cut red and pear-cut purple cubic zirconia are held by tiny sparkling leaf prongs on gold-plated metal, and the warm tone sharpens the contrast between the two colours.

rows.heading: Braid and Go
rows.body: Braid your hair back, pull on something plain and white, and let these short drops do the rest, an easy choice for office days or a birthday lunch.

rows.heading: Tied in Sparkle
rows.body: An open band brings two ends together across your finger: a sea-blue teardrop wrapped in sparkle on one side, a neatly tied pavé bow on the other.

rows.heading: Clear Sea Blue
rows.body: Pear-cut cubic zirconia in sea blue sits inside a ring of clear stones on a bright white setting, and that silvery frame keeps the blue cool and glassy.

rows.heading: Gift Already Wrapped
rows.body: It already looks like a wrapped present, which makes it an easy birthday gift for a best friend with a playful streak.

rows.heading: Red Starburst
rows.body: An oval red stone sits at the centre of a burst of clear stones, with dark rays between them, spreading across your finger like a firework.

rows.heading: Antique Gold Warmth
rows.body: Oval cubic zirconia in deep crimson is held in brass with an antique gold finish, and the darker metal makes both the red and the clear stones glow brighter.

rows.heading: Everyone Asks
rows.body: Wear it as your only ring with an embroidered salwar kameez to a dawat at your in-laws', and it becomes the piece everyone asks you about.

rows.heading: Side by Side
rows.body: A rose of layered, sparkling petals sits beside a square yellow stone, the two ends of an open band meeting on your finger, catching light from both sides.

rows.heading: Ice Beside Lemon
rows.body: Cushion-cut yellow cubic zirconia sits beside petals paved in clear stones, and all that bright white around it makes the yellow look warmer and sunnier.

rows.heading: Rose That Stays
rows.body: Slip it on for an anniversary dinner, a rose you can keep long after the real ones on the table have faded.

rows.heading: Pink Centrepiece
rows.body: A rectangle of pink sits inside layer after layer of clear stones, building a wide, glittering frame that covers your finger and flashes with every gesture.

rows.heading: Blush in Layers
rows.body: Rectangular-cut pink zircon is ringed by clear rounds and pear-shaped stones in a silver-tone setting, and the icy surround makes the pink look clearer and sweeter.

rows.heading: Wave Hello
rows.body: Wear it to a wedding reception with a sequined lehenga or plain chiffon saree, and every wave hello becomes a small flash of pink across the room.

rows.heading: Halo on Halo
rows.body: A round centre stone sits in a double halo of sparkle, and rows of stones run down each shoulder, so the whole top of your finger catches light.

rows.heading: Bright and Bridal
rows.body: A round zircon centre, ringed twice in smaller zircon on a bright silver-tone band, keeps the look clean and icy, exactly how a bridal ring should read.

rows.heading: Biye and Beyond
rows.body: Made for the biye day and every anniversary after it, a ring that stays on long after the wedding lights come down.

rows.heading: Vine and Blossom
rows.body: Dark vines twist around your finger, carrying a pink-and-white flower with a red centre, two closed buds, green leaves and tiny daisies, like a garden wrapped in a ring.

rows.heading: Near-Black Contrast
rows.body: A round crimson cubic zirconia sits in soft pink petals against an antique-finish band, and the deep, near-black metal makes the red and pink look even brighter.

rows.heading: Boishakh in Bloom
rows.body: Wear it with jasmine in your hair and a red-and-white saree for Pohela Boishakh, or give it to the friend who loves something a little unusual.

rows.heading: Heart Between Hearts
rows.body: A pink heart sits high in its prongs, with a smaller heart of clear sparkle tucked against each side, so three hearts line up across your finger.

rows.heading: Soft Pink Glow
rows.body: Heart-cut rose quartz in a soft pink sits on a silver-tone band between pavé clear stones, and the cool white setting keeps its blush gentle rather than sugary.

rows.heading: A Promise Kept
rows.body: Give it on an ordinary evening, just because, or slip it on her finger on date night when the words feel too big to say.

rows.heading: Double Frame
rows.body: Two squared-off halos frame a round centre stone like a window, and the band divides into twin pavé lines at each shoulder, adding more light as it goes.

rows.heading: Cool White Metal
rows.body: Round cubic zirconia is circled by rows of smaller stones on a platinum-plated setting, and that cool, bright metal lets the clear stones flash white without any warm cast.

rows.heading: Her Next Chapter
rows.body: A thoughtful gift for a bride-to-be to wear through her engagement and biye, and just as easy later with office shirts and everyday kurtis.

rows.heading: Round and Radiant
rows.body: One large round stone rises from a ring of tiny sparkle, while rows of small stones line the wide shoulders, so light catches it from every angle.

rows.heading: Rainbow Flashes
rows.body: Round zircon set in platinum-plated metal keeps everything cool and white, so the big centre stone throws flashes of colour against an icy, all-over sparkle.

rows.heading: Gift for Ammu
rows.body: Give it to your mother for her birthday, a ring bright enough for family weddings and simple enough for everyday wear with a cotton saree.

rows.heading: Edge to Edge
rows.body: Rows of round stones cover the top of a wide band, larger in the middle and finer at the edges, so it reads as one sheet of sparkle.

rows.heading: Seamless Shine
rows.body: Faceted zircon sits in rows on platinum-plated metal, and the cool white finish lets every stone blend into the next for a clean, even shine.

rows.heading: Years Well Kept
rows.body: Give it to your wife on your anniversary; it looks as right beside her wedding band as it does alone, bold in a quiet, grown-up way.

rows.heading: Chevron Lines
rows.body: Two V-shaped bands nest one inside the other, and a yellow teardrop rises from the point of the top band, drawing a sharp, flattering line along your finger.

rows.heading: Bright Yellow Point
rows.body: A pear-shaped yellow stone is ringed with tiny clear stones and set in silver-tone brass, so the yellow stays sunny and the pavé lines look crisp and cool.

rows.heading: Stack Your Way
rows.body: Wear both bands together for an evening out, or split them across two fingers for university days, and you get two looks from one small set.

rows.heading: Petal Halo
rows.body: A round centre stone opens into pointed petals, and the band splits into fine pavé lines at each side, so the flower seems to float on your finger.

rows.heading: Bright on Mehendi
rows.body: Zircon petals in round and pear shapes sit in a silver-tone setting, and with no colour to compete, the whole bloom flashes white and bright against mehendi-patterned hands.

rows.heading: Chand Raat Ready
rows.body: Put it on after your mehendi on chand raat, and it will still be catching the light through Eid morning, the dawats and every photo that follows.

rows.heading: Honey Curl
rows.body: Honey-coloured teardrops fan out around a curl of clear sparkle, shaped like a wave about to break, and the pendant hangs on a fine chain just below your collarbone.

rows.heading: Warm on Cool
rows.body: Pear-cut zircon in a warm honey shade is outlined in clear stones on a silver-tone setting, and that cool edge makes the golden colour glow like late sunlight.

rows.heading: Engagement Day Glow
rows.body: Wear it for your engagement with a soft ivory or beige saree, then bring it back for every anniversary when you want warmth without heavy bridal gold.

rows.heading: Turned on Point
rows.body: A square sea-blue stone, turned on its point, hangs from a fine chain, while matching earrings swing beneath small clear starbursts, echoing the colour at each ear.

rows.heading: Crisp Aqua
rows.body: Cushion-cut zircon in a clear aqua blue sits in rhodium-plated metal, and the bright white setting keeps the blue crisp and cool, lovely against a royal blue saree.

rows.heading: Already Matched
rows.body: Wear the full set to an Eid evening dawat, or give it to your wife, sister or mother as one gift that already goes together.

rows.heading: Flower Three Ways
rows.body: Round stones circle a larger centre to make each flower, sitting close at your lobes, on your finger and at the end of a fine chain.

rows.heading: Clear White Fire
rows.body: Round cubic zirconia sits high in slim claws on a silver-tone setting, so light reaches each stone from the sides and the whole flower stays bright.

rows.heading: Office to Dawat
rows.body: Small enough for the office, bright enough for a dawat in the evening. A sweet gift for a sister who likes her sparkle matched and simple.

rows.heading: Petals Around Pink
rows.body: Teardrop petals fan out from a soft pink centre, making a full round flower at the pendant, at each lobe and across the top of the ring.

rows.heading: Blush in White
rows.body: Pear-cut cubic zirconia rings the pink stone on a silver-tone setting, and all that white sparkle around it makes the blush centre look warmer and softer.

rows.heading: Birthday Bloom
rows.body: Give her the whole set on a birthday or an anniversary, and she has earrings, ring and pendant that match from the very first time she wears them.

rows.heading: Caught Snowfall
rows.body: Six pointed arms, each lined with tiny stones, spread from a softly glowing centre, so the pendant, studs and ring look like snowflakes that never melt.

rows.heading: Frost and Glow
rows.body: Cubic zirconia pavé covers every arm in a silver-tone setting, and the milky stone at the centre gives that bright white frost a soft, moonlit middle.

rows.heading: Winter Biye Bride
rows.body: Made for a winter biye or the reception after, this matched set looks soft against pale lace and ivory silk, from the stage to every photo.

rows.heading: Petals in Layers
rows.body: Rounded petals overlap like an opening rose around a peach centre, small gold-tone leaves peek from the edges, and the earrings swing beneath a slim pavé bar.

rows.heading: Two-Tone Warmth
rows.body: Tiny cubic zirconia pavé covers each silver-tone petal, peach stones cluster at the centre, and the gold-tone leaves add warmth that suits blush and champagne fabrics.

rows.heading: Eid Evening Trio
rows.body: One set covers the whole look for Eid evening visits: pendant at the neckline, drops at the ears, a flower on your hand as you pass the sweets.

rows.heading: Ocean Starburst
rows.body: A deep blue teardrop sits inside a starburst of smaller blue and clear stones, hanging from a little V at your throat and ears, with a matching ring.

rows.heading: Blue in Depth
rows.body: Pear-cut cubic zirconia in ocean blue is framed by lighter blue and clear stones on a silver-tone setting, so the centre reads darker and richer by contrast.

rows.heading: Blue for Bou-Bhat
rows.body: Pair it with a royal blue saree for the bou-bhat, or give it to a bride-to-be who wants her colour to be something other than red.

rows.heading: Endless Loops
rows.body: A round, glowing stone sits high in four claws, while looping openwork runs along each side of the band, dotted with tiny clear stones that wink as you move.

rows.heading: Moonlight on Silver
rows.body: A smooth moonstone cabochon shows a blue flash that drifts as you turn your hand, and the bright 925 sterling silver around it keeps that glow cool and clear.

rows.heading: A Quiet Promise
rows.body: Slip it onto her finger on your anniversary as a small promise kept. Slim enough for every day, from a kurti at university to dinner out.

rows.heading: Framed in Black
rows.body: A kite-shaped stone stands on its point along your finger, and small black marquise and round stones fan out from its sides like a crisp, dark frame.

rows.heading: Moss in Stone
rows.body: Kite-cut moss agate shows green, moss-like threads drifting through a pale stone, and bright 925 sterling silver keeps every branch of green easy to see.

rows.heading: Her Own Green
rows.body: For the bride-to-be who never wanted the usual white stone. Give it at the engagement, or on an anniversary, and watch her keep looking down at it.

rows.heading: Between Two Moons
rows.body: A pear-shaped stone rests inside a fine beaded halo between two small crescent moons, and twisting shoulders set with clear stones carry the sparkle down the band.

rows.heading: Sheen Meets Sparkle
rows.body: Pear-cut moonstone carries a soft blue sheen, and the halo of tiny clear stones in 925 sterling silver adds crisp sparkle so that gentle glow never looks flat.

rows.heading: Asked and Answered
rows.body: Hold it out at the proposal, or on the evening the families meet for the engagement, and let a little moonlight speak for you.

rows.heading: Mid-Flight Pair
rows.body: Two lines of tiny stones wrap past each other around your finger, each ending in a small butterfly, so one seems to land just as the other takes off.

rows.heading: Wings That Glint
rows.body: Pear-shaped wings are paved in tiny cubic zirconia, like the band itself, on rhodium-plated brass whose bright finish keeps every stone looking clean and white.

rows.heading: A Friend's Birthday
rows.body: A light-hearted birthday gift for a friend who is always on the move. It looks right with jeans and a kurti, and still holds its own at a dawat.

rows.heading: One Bold Oval
rows.body: A single large oval stone stands high in four claws on an open band, while the other end curves past it in a smooth, polished teardrop of metal.

rows.heading: Facets Wide Open
rows.body: Oval-cut cubic zirconia, set open at the sides, pulls light in from every angle, and the platinum-plated brass band keeps the setting bright and white around it.

rows.heading: Let It Talk
rows.body: Wear it to a birthday dinner or a date night and keep the rest simple. One big oval on your hand is enough to start the conversation.

rows.heading: Tail Feathers Open
rows.body: A peacock rests at one end of the open band while its tail fans across your finger in teardrop feathers, each with a deep blue eye at its heart.

rows.heading: Two Shades Deep
rows.body: Blue zircon in two shades fills every feather, paler stones around a darker centre, and the silver-tone setting between them lets each blue stay clear and separate.

rows.heading: Never Dressed Quietly
rows.body: Wear it to a wedding dawat with a blue or green saree, or give it on an anniversary to the woman who has never once dressed quietly.

rows.heading: Green Centre Stage
rows.body: A rectangular green stone sits at the centre of a wide halo of clear pear-shaped stones that point outward like petals, sitting wide across your finger.

rows.heading: White Frames Green
rows.body: A step-cut green stone is ringed in clear sparkle on a silver-tone setting, and that bright white frame keeps the green rich, even beside fresh mehndi.

rows.heading: Across the Room
rows.body: Made for an anniversary party or a big family biye, it catches the camera flash from across the room. A bold gift for the cousin getting married.

rows.heading: A Painted Garden
rows.body: Blue-and-white flowers with red centres crowd together with little lilac rosettes, each holding a green stone, all resting on a dark band shaped like twisting branches.

rows.heading: Petal by Petal
rows.body: Painted petals fade from white to blue inside gold-tone edges, with small red, green and lilac stones set among them, so the colour changes as your hand moves.

rows.heading: Mela Day Colour
rows.body: Wear it for Pohela Boishakh, a mela with friends, or any day you want colour on your hand. A happy birthday gift for the friend who loves flowers.

rows.heading: Little and Large
rows.body: A larger butterfly and a tiny one face each other across the open band, their wings outlined in fine beading and filled with stones that flicker as you move.

rows.heading: Warm, Not Icy
rows.body: The 925 silver band has a warm gold-tone finish, and tiny clear stones across each wing pick up that warmth, so the sparkle looks soft rather than icy.

rows.heading: Fresh Starts
rows.body: Give it to a friend starting something new, a first job or a new city. It is delicate enough to wear every day, from the office to evening tea.

rows.heading: Crescent and Bell
rows.body: A turquoise-blue top leads into a crescent holding a pink teardrop, then a domed bell edged with a fringe of pink drops that sway as you turn.

rows.heading: Pink Meets Turquoise
rows.body: Pink pear-cut cubic zirconia hangs against bands of tiny turquoise-blue stones on a silver-tone setting, and the cool blue makes every pink drop look sweeter and brighter.

rows.heading: Swing Through Eid
rows.body: Wear these jhumkas for Eid with a pastel salwar kameez, or to a friend's gaye holud, and let them swing through every round of photos.

rows.heading: Falling Blue
rows.body: An open wing of blue stones sits at your lobe, and two strands of blue teardrops fall from it at different lengths, swinging out of step as you move.

rows.heading: Outlined in Light
rows.body: Pear and marquise cubic zirconia in deep blue fill the wing inside an outline of clear pavé, on a silver-tone setting that keeps the blue looking inky and rich.

rows.heading: Hair Up, Please
rows.body: Pin your hair up for a date night so the full drop shows from every side. A birthday gift for the sister who always reaches for blue.

rows.heading: Three Tones Down
rows.body: A gold-tone flower sits at your lobe, a paler bloom hangs beneath it, and a rounded teardrop of tiny white stones finishes the line, swaying gently below.

rows.heading: Warm to Bright
rows.body: Baguette and marquise cubic zirconia shape each petal, and the gold-plated top gives way to lighter tones below, so the pair sits happily beside gold or silver pieces.

rows.heading: On Their Own
rows.body: Let these carry a reception look on their own with champagne or gold embroidery, bright enough for the stage and for every family photo after.

rows.heading: Teardrop in Violet
rows.body: A large open teardrop of round purple stones hangs from a small purple drop at your lobe, with a slim pavé centre inside that catches light as it swings.

rows.heading: Purple on Dark
rows.body: Round cubic zirconia in rich purple is set in two close rows on a dark-tone setting that almost disappears, so the violet reads deep and unbroken.

rows.heading: Guest of Honour
rows.body: Wear them as a wedding guest with a purple or silver saree, or give them to your sister for her mehndi night.

rows.heading: Sprig and Stone
rows.body: A deep green teardrop hangs inside a fine halo, and a sprig of tiny leaves climbs its side to the curved hook, as if it grew there.

rows.heading: Green, Warmly Framed
rows.body: Pear-cut green cubic zirconia sits in a gold-tone setting ringed with small clear stones, and the warm metal pulls out the green, just as gold zari does on velvet.

rows.heading: Daylight Green
rows.body: Catch the afternoon sun at an engagement lunch or an Eid visit, and the green turns bright as glass. A gift for the mother who always wears green.

rows.heading: Magenta Waterfall
rows.body: A curved band of clear stones folds over at the top, then spills into uneven strands of magenta stones that fall toward your jaw and shimmer with every step.

rows.heading: Colour Packed Close
rows.body: Round and marquise cubic zirconia in magenta crowd tightly on a dark-tone setting, with a cap of clear pavé above, so the colour looks dense and the sparkle sharp.

rows.heading: Anniversary Colour
rows.body: Match them to a magenta or red saree for the biye, or wear them to your anniversary dinner and let the colour do all the talking.

rows.heading: Butterfly Swing
rows.body: A butterfly in turquoise-blue hangs from a slim pavé hook, and three blue drops swing beneath its wings, the middle one longest, framed in a small oval of clear stones.

rows.heading: Morning Sky Blue
rows.body: Light blue cubic zirconia fills the wings and drops on a gold-tone setting, with clear pavé tracing every edge, so the blue looks as fresh as a morning sky.

rows.heading: Turn Your Head
rows.body: Wear them to a friend's birthday lunch or an outdoor biye with a sky blue saree, then turn your head and let the drops do the rest.

rows.heading: Tier Upon Tier
rows.body: Three rounded tiers, small to large, step down from a teardrop stud, packed with scattered baguettes and cinched by narrow bands of sparkle where each tier meets the next.

rows.heading: Light From Behind
rows.body: Baguette cubic zirconia is set at scattered angles across an open gold-tone frame, so light enters from behind as well as the front and the whole drop glitters.

rows.heading: Made for Benarasi
rows.body: Pair them with a red Benarasi on the biye day, or with a simple silk saree at Eid, when you want your earrings to carry the whole look.

rows.heading: Folded Ribbon Line
rows.body: A small kite-shaped top leads into a long, twisting triangle edged in clear pavé and packed with green ovals, so the drop folds like a ribbon along your neck.

rows.heading: Green Meets Gold
rows.body: Oval and round green cubic zirconia sit inside a gold-plated frame, and the warm metal makes the green look deeper, like leaves in late sun.

rows.heading: Let Them Speak
rows.body: These do the talking on a date night, so keep the rest simple: a plain black kurti or dark saree, hair tucked back, and nothing at the neck.

rows.heading: Trailing Petals
rows.body: Petals of clear pavé open at the lobe, then smaller petal links trail downward, each holding green stones, until a single green teardrop swings at the end.

rows.heading: Fresh Green Light
rows.body: Pear and marquise green cubic zirconia rest on petals of clear pavé in a bright white setting, so the green reads fresh and cool rather than dark.

rows.heading: Eid Morning Green
rows.body: Green feels right on Eid morning, with a white or mint salwar kameez and your hair pinned back so the petals can swing freely through the day.

rows.heading: A Colour Ladder
rows.body: A teal-blue top stone leads a slim column of four halo-framed stones in pink and shades of blue, ending in a round pearl that sways as you turn.

rows.heading: Pastel Meets Pearl
rows.body: Cushion-cut cubic zirconia in pink and aqua sit in thin clear halos on gold plating, and the warm metal keeps the pastels glowing beside the pearl's soft white.

rows.heading: The Bou-Bhat Bride
rows.body: For a bride who wants colour that still feels soft, these sit sweetly beside a pastel lehenga at the bou-bhat, then return for every reception after.

rows.heading: Flower and Pearl
rows.body: A five-petal flower in clear pavé sits flat at the lobe with a yellow stone at its heart, and a teardrop pearl hangs just below, moving softly.

rows.heading: Honey and Cream
rows.body: Clear cubic zirconia pavé fills each petal on 18K gold plating, and that warm base turns the sparkle honey-soft so the white pearl glows beside it.

rows.heading: Easy to Give
rows.body: Small enough for the office, pretty enough for a birthday dawat, these make an easy gift for your mother or sister.

rows.heading: A Slow Blush
rows.body: A pink pear stone crowned in clear pavé sits at the lobe, above a shell-shaped drop that blushes from white to pink and ends in a round pearl.

rows.heading: Pink on Silver
rows.body: Clear and pink cubic zirconia are set in a silver-tone finish that keeps the pink gentle, while a pink heart and a pearl drop add one last soft gleam.

rows.heading: Anniversary Dinner
rows.body: Wear them with a pink saree to an anniversary dinner, or give them to the sister who always picks rose tones. Soft by day, bright by candlelight.

rows.heading: Peacock Fan
rows.body: From a small clear pear at the lobe, the earring fans out like a peacock's tail, clear marquise stones giving way to purple pears that catch light as you turn.

rows.heading: Violet on Gold
rows.body: Pear and marquise cubic zirconia in purple and clear sit in gold-plated brass, each purple stone edged in tiny pavé, so the violet looks richer against warm gold.

rows.heading: Birthday Spotlight
rows.body: Save them for your birthday dinner with a deep maroon or black outfit and your hair swept back, so all that purple gets the spotlight.

rows.heading: Full Bloom
rows.body: A full open flower, three centimetres across, sits right on the lobe, its layered petals paved edge to edge around a dark centre ringed with clear sparks.

rows.heading: Rose-Red Depth
rows.body: Deep rose-red cubic zirconia cover every petal, with pear-cut stones laid in a ring, and the dark setting behind them makes the colour look even richer.

rows.heading: No Necklace Needed
rows.body: A stud this bold needs no necklace. Wear them to a dawat with a magenta saree, or with a plain kurti whenever you want one bright thing.

rows.heading: Unbroken Line
rows.body: One unbroken line of round stones circles the wrist, each in its own little crown of gold-tone prongs, so the bracelet bends and flashes with every gesture.

rows.heading: Little Gold Suns
rows.body: Round-cut clear cubic zirconia sit high in gold-tone settings with beaded rims that frame each stone like a tiny sun, and a fold-over clasp with an extension sets the fit.

rows.heading: Made to Stack
rows.body: Wear it alone with a watch at the office, or stack it with bangles for a dawat. A simple anniversary gift she can wear every day.

rows.heading: String of Lanterns
rows.body: Round stones in purple, red and champagne take turns around the wrist, each ringed in a clear halo and joined by tiny clear rounds, like a string of lit lanterns.

rows.heading: Every Colour Clear
rows.body: Round-cut cubic zirconia in three warm and cool shades sit in bright white halo settings, and that clean silver-tone frame keeps each colour crisp and separate.

rows.heading: Wedding Guest Colour
rows.body: With this much colour on one wrist, a plain saree is all you need. Wear it to a cousin's biye, or gift it to the sister who loves colour.

rows.heading: Heart After Heart
rows.body: Pink hearts link one after another around the wrist, each outlined in a fine clear halo, and the whole line flexes softly when you lift your hand.

rows.heading: Pink in Outline
rows.body: Heart-cut pink cubic zirconia sit in a silver-tone brass setting edged with clear stones, and that bright white border keeps the pink soft but lit from every edge.

rows.heading: Said Without Words
rows.body: A row of hearts says it plainly. Give it to your wife for no reason at all, and use the extension piece to adjust the fit to her wrist.

name: Luminous Gold Cubic Zircon Tennis Bracelet

rows.heading: One Bright Centre
rows.body: Small round clusters of pavé run in a neat line to one larger round stone in a halo, which sits on top of your wrist like a bright full stop.

rows.heading: Warm White Sparkle
rows.body: Clear cubic zirconia fill every link on 18K gold plating, and the warm yellow tone gives the white sparkle a soft glow, brightest at the larger centre stone.

rows.heading: Everyday Keepsake
rows.body: Fine enough for every day at university or the office, with a centre stone that still feels special. Give it to a friend on her birthday.

rows.heading: Paisley Frame
rows.body: A single pink rectangle sits at the centre between two paisley curves of clear sparkle, and the band narrows into a slim line that lies flat on the wrist.

rows.heading: Blush on White
rows.body: A step-cut pink cubic zirconia is set among clear pear and marquise stones on rhodium plating, and that cool white shine lets the pink read clean and soft.

rows.heading: In Every Photo
rows.body: Made for the engagement evening, when your hands are in every photo. It sits neatly beside a new ring and looks just as right at the reception.

rows.heading: Flower Centrepiece
rows.body: A run of round stones leads to a centrepiece: one larger stone in a clear halo, framed by small marquise petals and a clear flower cluster on either side.

rows.heading: Pink or Plum
rows.body: Round and marquise cubic zirconia in soft pink or deep purple sit in a bright silver-tone setting, with clear flower clusters that keep either shade looking fresh.

rows.heading: Choose Your Shade
rows.body: Pick the pink for a birthday lunch or the purple for an evening dawat, or give one to a friend who always matches her bangles to her outfit.

rows.heading: Sunlit Centre
rows.body: Clusters of clear pear stones link like small petals around the wrist, leading to an oval centre where one square yellow stone glows inside a ring of white sparkle.

rows.heading: Warm Against Cool
rows.body: A square-cut yellow cubic zirconia sits among clear pear-cut stones in a silver-tone setting, and all that cool white around it makes the yellow look warmer.

rows.heading: Holud Day Yellow
rows.body: Yellow is the colour of gaye holud, and this bracelet carries it to the wrist without a single marigold. Give it to the bride-to-be, or wear it yourself.

name: Purple Tassel Necklace and Earrings Set

rows.heading: Teardrop Fringe
rows.body: A fringe of purple teardrops hangs from small leafy sprigs along the neckline, longer and shorter in turn, and matching earrings end in the same teardrop.

rows.heading: Violet in Frame
rows.body: Pear-cut purple cubic zirconia, each framed in clear stones, hang from a bright silver-tone setting that keeps the violet cool and vivid against skin and fabric.

rows.heading: The Whole Look
rows.body: One set, nothing else to choose. Wear it with a lilac saree on Eid evening, or to a wedding where you want the neckline to carry the look.

rows.heading: Curl and Sway
rows.body: An open frame of curling scrollwork, outlined in clear pavé, narrows at the top and widens like a chandelier, finishing in a fringe of five pink teardrops that sway.

rows.heading: Floating in Light
rows.body: Marquise and pear-cut pink cubic zirconia sit inside a bright silver-tone outline of clear stones, so the pink looks like it is floating in light.

rows.heading: Reception Swing
rows.body: Wear them to a friend's reception with your hair up and a soft pink or ivory saree, and let the fringe do its quiet swaying all evening.

rows.heading: Flower and Fruit
rows.body: A five-petal flower with a tiny orange centre sits at the lobe, green leaves tucked above and below, and a large yellow teardrop hangs from it like ripe fruit.

rows.heading: Golden Warmth
rows.body: Cubic zirconia pavé in clear, orange and green sits on gold plating, and the faceted yellow pear in its beaded rim picks up the warmth of the metal.

rows.heading: Falgun Yellow
rows.body: Wear them on Pohela Falgun, when the city turns yellow, with a yellow saree and flowers in your hair, and they match without even trying.

rows.heading: Stained-Glass Bloom
rows.body: An oval lilac stone at the lobe holds an open teardrop frame of clear pavé, with a flower of coloured stones blooming inside it, like a tiny stained-glass window.

rows.heading: Threaded in Gold
rows.body: Cubic zirconia in red, pink, purple, olive and peach are set in curling gold-tone petals, and the warm metal ties every colour together like old embroidery.

rows.heading: Birthday Brights
rows.body: Wear them to a birthday party with a plain dark saree and let them bring the colour, or gift them to a friend who never wears just one shade.

rows.heading: Feathered Ombré
rows.body: An oval green stud leads into a long almond-shaped drop, layered with marquise stones like feathers, that shades from deep green to clear at its tip.

rows.heading: Fade to Light
rows.body: Marquise-cut cubic zirconia overlap in rows on a gold-tone setting, green fading to aqua and clear, so the drop looks darkest near the face and brightest at the end.

rows.heading: Wedding in Green
rows.body: Match them to a green katan saree at a wedding, gold at the border and hair in a low bun, and they finish the look on their own.

rows.heading: Open Window
rows.body: A small tilted square at the lobe holds a larger one with soft corners and a round window near its top, so light shows through as it swings.

rows.heading: Polka Dot Sparkle
rows.body: Round berry-red cubic zirconia are scattered like polka dots across clear pavé on rhodium plating, and the cool white base makes each red dot look sharper.

rows.heading: One Confident Detail
rows.body: Bold shapes for a university farewell or an office party, when a plain outfit needs one confident detail. Tie your hair back and let them show.

rows.heading: Bloom and Square
rows.body: The open band ends in two pieces that sit side by side: a layered flower of pavé petals with a clear centre, and a square yellow stone beside it.

rows.heading: Drop of Sunlight
rows.body: Clear and yellow zircon sit on platinum-plated copper, and that cool white shine makes the cushion-cut yellow look like a drop of sunlight beside the petals.

rows.heading: A Sister's Birthday
rows.body: Adjustable, so it is an easy gift for your sister on her birthday. She can wear it with a white-and-red saree on Pohela Boishakh and every ordinary day after.

rows.heading: Rope and Stars
rows.body: An oval stone rests in a twisted rope frame on a slim band, with tiny clear stones at either end and dotted along the band like small stars.

rows.heading: Flicker of Colour
rows.body: The opal flickers with flashes of blue and pink as your hand moves, held in 925 sterling silver with a gold-tone finish that warms its milky white.

rows.heading: Everyday Shimmer
rows.body: Slim enough to wear daily with a winter cardigan, yet pretty beside wedding bangles too. Give it to a friend whose favourite colour changes with the light.
